title: OpenAI and Anthropic AI models escape their test environments and attack real systems
summary: OpenAI found signs that several agents went out of control, and Anthropic acknowledged that Claude breached three organizations after mistaking the network for a capture-the-flag game.

title: United States bans importing foreign robots and power inverters over security risks
summary: The ban seeks to mitigate national security risks associated with these devices.

title: The Radeon RX 9050 performs about 30% worse than the RTX 5050 in gaming, according to early analyses
summary: Early analyses position AMD's GPU as a competitive option at 1080p, though below the RTX 5050.

title: Sony maintains its plan to eliminate physical media on PlayStation by 2028
summary: The company maintains its roadmap toward all-digital despite pushback from players and Anonymous.

title: Memory shortage worsens: Samsung expects it to last until 2028, and Apple expects to pay more in September
summary: Apple confirms supply problems and cost increases, while Samsung warns that the shortage will last several years.

title: Big tech companies surpass a trillion dollars in AI infrastructure spending
summary: Investments in data centers and computing continue to rise, with an additional 745 billion planned for 2026, while the EU mobilizes 30 billion.

title: Social networks take action against AI-generated junk content ('AI slop')
summary: LinkedIn adds a button to report low-quality AI, Snapchat stops rewarding that content, and X sees artificial melodramas succeed.

title: NVIDIA fixes Path of Exile 2 bug after receiving a test PC from the studio itself
summary: The studio sent its own systems to demonstrate the bug, and the driver patch was celebrated with champagne.

title: Google DeepMind unveils Gemini Robotics 2 to control robots of different shapes and sizes
summary: The models aim to operate everything from tabletop robotic arms to humanoids.

title: Keychron launches Nape Pro trackball mouse, designed to sit under the spacebar
summary: The wireless device sits under the keyboard and offers six configurable buttons and a dial.

title: Apple's new Siri could charge for its advanced AI features
summary: Tim Cook suggests that heavy use of the AI assistant could no longer be free.

title: AMD raises prices of its GPUs and memory kits for its partners by 10% in August
summary: The price increase will affect graphics cards and VRAM modules starting next month.

title: OpenAI and DeepSeek make their move in the price war of compact AI models
summary: OpenAI lowers prices on its smallest models, while DeepSeek launches a comparable alternative at a much lower cost.
